data_fields.name: pool size cap (absent in donor; Frankendom must add)

best_idea: A dense instance pool with swap-remove and deferred bulk upload lets a browser game draw hundreds of blood, decal and FX objects in one call, if the grow check runs only when a new id is added.
decision_why: The pool shape transfers to WebGL instancing for decals and FX; adapt it by checking the id before growing and by making debug tracking opt-in, and add a size cap the donor lacks. Object binding to engine unit ids is rejected because Frankendom draw objects are not engine units.
acceptance: In a fight with three attackers and a heavy hit, blood and sparks render as one batched draw per pool, a refused duplicate push leaves the pool capacity unchanged (a test asserts it), and the pool never exceeds its zone-data cap.
